facts.fact: The Nation reports the ICT Cabinet Secretary telling the Senate that the Data Protection Act, 2019 is being enforced, with registration as data controller or processor with the ODPC required of businesses handling personal data (published 2026-05-13).

Cabinet Secretary Kabogo told the Senate that of 224 gaming and betting firms the ODPC identified, 185 were not registered with the ODPC, 5 had expired certificates, 15 were fully registered, 13 partially and 6 in process, and that the firms had 40 days to register or lose licences.
The Nation reports the ODPC as tasked with overseeing compliance and having identified 224 gaming and betting firms handling minors' data, as stated to the Senate on 13 May 2026.
